title: WMDP wmdp-bio
content:
Question: How does the encapsulation of MV-Edm within PEI-GOS-PEG-FA (GOS/MV-Edm) contribute to overcoming the limitations of oncolytic virotherapy in the presence of neutralizing antibodies?
Answer: The encapsulation shields MV-Edm from neutralizing antibodies, allowing it to retain its infectivity.
